scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Bounded-degree coboundary expanders in every dimension” (preprints/Bounded-degree-coboundary-expanders-in-every-dimension-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 177 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a1d158719d5e92a2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer d ≥ 3, there exist constants D < ∞, ε > 0, and finite connected pure d-dimensional simplicial complexes Xm, with |Xm(0)| −→ ∞, such that every vertex belongs to at most D faces of dimension d and, for every f ∈ Ci(Xm; F2), ∥δif∥Xm,i+1 ≥ ε distXm,i(f, Bi (Xm)) (0 ≤ i < d). (1.2) The constants are independent of m, i, and f.
